arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess only material 21/63-session geopolitical and trade-policy transmission channels using available BIS policy material and company disclosures where needed: semiconductor/networking supply-chain or export-control exposure, and platform/regulatory cross-border risk. Distinguish documented facts from inferences, cite evidence IDs, and stop after the most material available policy document and latest relevant disclosure; explicitly state unresolved exposure quantification.
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether policy or geopolitical developments could disrupt demand, supply, or valuation for the semiconductor, networking, platform, and Nasdaq-heavy exposures beyond the macro baseline.
